semiconductor_relevance: High — Eastern Globe specializes in high-performance materials for the semiconductor industry, particularly in substrates and components essential for advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: Eastern Globe Co., Ltd. provides optimized materials for the semiconductor and advanced industries, focusing on high-temperature resistant and durable substrates. Their offerings include Si3N4 substrates, PBN products, and GaN wafers, supported by strict quality control and rapid response to market demands.
capabilities: Si3N4 substrates for power semiconductor applications
Pyrolytic Boron Nitride (PBN) products for high-purity processes
GaN wafers for next-generation power semiconductors
Probe cards and DUT boards for testing applications
